hero.subtitle: DevForge is a platform built improvement by improvement — from React to Next.js, from Stripe payments to WhatsApp API. Real code, real production.

features.title: What will you learn?
features.subtitle: Each technology is implemented in a real project, with clean, secure code and best practices.
features.auth_desc: Google OAuth, NextAuth.js, JWT, refresh tokens, protected routes, and session management.
features.payments_desc: Checkout sessions, signed webhooks, recurring subscriptions, and billing portal.
features.whatsapp_desc: Send messages, Meta templates, webhooks to receive messages, and automated replies.
features.security_desc: reCAPTCHA v3, CSP headers, XSS prevention with DOMPurify, rate limiting with Redis.
features.nextjs_desc: App Router, Server Components, Prisma ORM, Supabase PostgreSQL, and strict TypeScript.
features.pwa_desc: Service Worker, mobile installable, offline support, sitemap, Open Graph, and Core Web Vitals.
